'''Ool''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ool system/Legends|Ool system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the world to the [[Avidich system/Legends|Avidich]] and [[Shihon system/Legends|Shihon systems]]. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the Chiss Ascendancy established large circular plots of [[Farm/Legends|farmland]] across the surface of Ool.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ool was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square E-8.<ref name="TEA" />
